decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The amended proposal, by reason of its position, size, height, design and appearance, would be an inappropriate development for Wilton Avenue and the area, failing to maintain and enhance the appearance and character of the building and the area, as well as having an adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by adjoining residents, by reason of a lack of sufficient sunlight and daylight information, contrary to London Plan policy D4, Local Plan policies CC1; CC2, and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 2 - The amended proposal, by reason of its turning point, requires vehicles to use the public footway to reverse during and after construction, harm the safety of the local transport network. The proposals, therefore, would be contrary to London Plan policy D4; T4, Local Plan policies EC2 and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 3 - The amended proposal, by reason of the absence of an updated fire safety plan, fails to achieve the highest standards of fire safety, would be contrary to London Plan policy D12 and the intent of the National Planning Policy Framework.
description:
Variation of condition 2, approved drawings, to allow changes to the external staircase, increase in height of the building, enlargement of the hardstanding, additional cycle storage and solar panels to planning permission 00354/C/P1 - P/2021/2466 approved 17/12/2021
for the erection of two blocks of flats consisting of a part one part three storey and a three storey building to create six flats including associated cycle storage, landscaping, refuse and recycling storage with the retention of existing electrical substation following the demolition of the existing garages
